model.measuredAxes: Transverse X, total vertical Y including the stack, longitudinal Z. Bounds measured with Three.js Box3.setFromObject on unscaled runtime model.

iterations.name: repair-geometry-first
iterations.observation: Initial new sole and compact brow exposed body/rail clearance, toe support and assumptions tied to the former four extruded slabs.

iterations.name: repair-geometry-second
iterations.observation: Real hull volume and raised wheelhouse improved the native side view. The pool turn, forward rabbit feet, shore props and transfer banks still needed room.

iterations.name: repair-fit4
iterations.observation: Both physical hull routes cleared; the large neighbors brushed a side guard and an outer Reef rabbit foot missed the Wrack approach.

iterations.name: repair-fit5
iterations.observation: The failing body/rail index and overlap bounds identified when an animal rotated beside the inlet gate.

iterations.name: repair-fit6
iterations.observation: Changing the turning interval cleared the guards, but a rotating rabbit still brushed its neighbor. Some geometry runs also experienced host contention.

iterations.name: repair-fit7
iterations.observation: Forward-seat banks separated the rotating rabbit. A post and the inner Shell Pool footing then needed refitting.

iterations.name: repair-full
iterations.observation: Full sampled subset transfers and stable seating passed in both orientations. This run also identified the Wrack turning tip, land prop proximity and a submillimeter mismatch between the stern extremum and axial wake reach.

iterations.name: repair-last-contacts
iterations.observation: Returning high-shore seats to the proven approach removed the prop overlap. The remaining two failures were the same outside rabbit toe on Shell Pool.

iterations.name: repair-final-contacts
iterations.observation: Shell Pool received another 0.06 world units of transverse dock width. Real-body support, prop/hull clearance and contact tests passed.

coverage: Final full-suite outcome in ../units.txt. Real meshes, every capacity-legal six-space roster, both headings, draft bands at each dry authored tide, all subset transfer selections and 1,001 samples along each route/heading. Foot and hull checks sample the motion and are not a swept-volume or physical-device proof.
